mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, conditions are clear at Badger Prairie County Park under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The Verona Plan Commission has several items on the agenda for their October 5th meeting, including site plans and certified survey maps for developments on Country View Court and South Main Street. Additionally, the city continues to focus on long-term growth through the ongoing Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown Farmer's Market, and even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In a report covering September 14th through September 28th, police responded to a retail theft on September 21st where a suspect was identified stealing Swedish Fish candy from a store on East Verona Avenue.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
